jobs.summary: Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

sections.title: Total Rewards
paras: At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

sections.title: Flexible Working
paras: At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

sections.title: Our Commitment to Authenticity
paras: We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

sections.title: Fraudulent Employment Offers
paras: Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

jobs.summary:
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

sections.title: Instacart is a Flex First team
paras: There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

sections.title: Why this role is on the menu

The Account Manager who fills this role is responsible for building trusted CPG relationships, maximizing advertisers value on Instacart’s platform and partnering on initiatives to widen how brands invest in our ad products. Twelve months from now, the advertisers you partner with should see Instacart as a growth partner whose recommendations they act on.

jobs.title: Professional Services Consultant, Application Security
jobs.blurb: At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized"…
jobs.summary: At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

sections.title: Available Locations:
bullets: San Francisco Bay Area
Austin, TX
Washington DC
New York, NY

sections.title: About the role:
paras: Cloudflare provides advisory and hands-on-keyboard implementation and migration services for enterprise customers. As an Professional Services Consultant for Application Security and Performance, you are an individual contributor working in the post-sales landscape, responsible for the technical execution of solutions and guidance to our customers to get the most value possible from their Cloudflare investment. You are an expert in Layer 7 products like: DDoS Protection, WAF, API Gateway, Bot Management, Certificates Manager, Rate Limiting, SSL and Page Shield.

This position has working hours Monday to Friday 09:00 a.m. to 06:00 p.m. Occasionally, we support our customers during the weekends for specific changes that need to be done outside of their business hours. Travel is expected at 30%.

sections.title: What you will do:
bullets: Plan and deliver timely and organized services for customers, ensure customers see the full value in Cloudflare’s products and advice on product best practices.

Implement changes on behalf of the customer in the Cloudflare environment following the customer’s change management process. Provide guidance to the customer to configure their CPEs and integration points.
Troubleshoot implementation issues and collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering and other teams to assist technical escalations.

Contribute towards the success of the organization through knowledge sharing activities such as contributing to internal and external documentation, answering technical Q&A, and helping to iterate on best practices. Support building operational assets like templates, automation scripts, procedures, workflows, etc.

sections.title: Experience might include a combination of the skills below:
bullets: 5+ years of experience in a customer facing position as a Customer Engineer, Security Engineer, Implementation Engineer, Onboarding Engineer, Consultant, Technical Support Engineer, Solutions Architect, and/or Systems Engineer.
Layers and protocols of the OSI model, such as TCP/IP, TLS, DNS, HTTP
Deep understanding of Internet and Security technologies such as DDoS, Web Application Firewall, Certificates, DNS, CDN, Analytics and Logs.
Demonstrated experience with a scripting language (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Bash) and a desire to expand those skills.
Working experience with security aspects of an internet property, such as Firewalls, WAFs, Bot Management, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS.
Performance aspects of an internet property, such as Speed, Latency, Caching, HTTP/2, TLSv1.3.
Working experience with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform.
Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines, prioritize between competing demands and manage uncertainty.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Senior Majors Account Manager to join our Strategic Sales Team, responsible for a portfolio of Cloudflare’s largest and most strategic existing customers. Your primary mission is to retain, develop, and expand these relationships by deepening executive alignment, accelerating platform adoption, and identifying significant growth opportunities across customer divisions, business units, and international operations. Success requires a sophisticated blend of strategic account management, enterprise sales execution, customer advocacy, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.

As a Senior Majors Account Manager, you will own your customer portfolio end-to-end, acting as the single accountable leader for long-term account strategy, retention, renewals, and expansion. You will build multi-year account plans, establish trusted executive relationships, lead strategic business reviews, and orchestrate virtual teams across Customer Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, and Partners. You will connect Cloudflare’s capabilities to each customer’s most important business and technology priorities, positioning Cloudflare as an indispensable long-term platform partner. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will actively leverage AI tools across account research, planning, executive engagement, value analysis, meeting preparation, and pipeline management—using them to improve both customer outcomes and the effectiveness of your own execution.

sections.title: Responsibilities
paras: Strategic Account Growth & Retention: Own the retention, renewal, and expansion of a defined portfolio of strategic Majors accounts. Develop and execute growth strategies across products, divisions, subsidiaries, geographies, and use cases. Maintain strong visibility into renewal risk, competitive threats, and customer sentiment while consistently achieving retention and expansion targets.

Strategic Account Planning: Develop and maintain comprehensive, multi-year account plans grounded in each customer’s business strategy, technology roadmap, organisational structure, buying processes, and competitive landscape. Identify whitespace and prioritise opportunities according to customer value, platform fit, and revenue potential. Ensure account plans remain current, actionable, and aligned across the wider Cloudflare team.

Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain broad, multi-threaded relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level. Establish yourself as a trusted strategic advisor by bringing relevant industry insight, a clear point of view, and thoughtful recommendations. Lead executive business reviews that demonstrate value delivered, align on future priorities, and create a shared multi-year vision.

sections.title: Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
bullets: 8+ years of experience in strategic enterprise technology sales or account management, with a substantial track record of achieving multi-million-euro retention, renewal, and expansion targets within Majors, strategic, or named accounts.

Proven strategic account farmer: Demonstrated success expanding large existing customers through deeper platform adoption, new use cases, additional products, new buying centres, business units, subsidiaries, and international operations—not simply managing renewals.
A strong record of building and executing multi-year account strategies that deliver durable customer relationships, high retention, predictable renewals, and sustained revenue growth.

Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), Connectivity, Developer Platforms, Edge Computing and Public Cloud , with the ability to engage credibly with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior infrastructure leaders.

Proven ability to understand complex enterprise IT architectures and map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures, connecting technical capabilities and realised value to measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated success leading complex expansion and renewal cycles across procurement, legal, information security, technical, financial, and executive stakeholders.
Experience identifying customer adoption or relationship risks early and coordinating cross-functional action to protect retention and improve customer outcomes.

Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context, such as prospect research, executive outreach personalisation, account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, or pipeline management . You can explain specifically how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective.

sections.title: What Makes Cloudflare Special?
paras: We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Trip Planning
jobs.blurb: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays…
jobs.summary:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: The Guest product team owns and builds the end-to-end journey guests take to travel with us, from the first idea through the trip itself. Trip planning is where that journey becomes intelligent: a team of engineers, applied researchers, designers, and data scientists building an AI planning agent that can understand what guests are looking for, and reason across homes, experiences, services and more to assemble a real trip. We're building toward a future where Airbnb feels like a knowledgeable travel companion that plans alongside you.

As Product Manager for AI trip planning, you will own the strategy and execution for this agent — one of Airbnb's most ambitious bets on an AI-native product. You'll define what it means for an agent to plan a trip well: how it asks the right questions, reasons about tradeoffs guests care about, and turns intent into a bookable trip spanning homes, experiences, and services. You’ll take the product from a demo to a system millions of guests rely on, and the work will be measured in bookings across categories and guest satisfaction at global scale. You’ll communicate these new AI features to the world by distilling the complex ideas into simple, delightful, and well-received products.
Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in San Francisco, CA to be able to conduct their work.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
bullets: Define and drive the roadmap for a multi-turn agent that can plan trips with guests along their travel journey
Set the quality bar for agent behavior: what a good plan looks like, where the agent should defer to the guest, and how it recovers when it's wrong
Own the cross-category planning problem and sequence work with Homes, Experiences, Services, and Hotels so the agent can plan across the full inventory
Work with ML engineers and applied researchers on model strategy, evaluation frameworks, and experiment design
Make prioritization calls when guest trust, planning quality, latency, cost, marketplace health, and revenue pull against each other
Keep cross-functional partners such as Search & Discovery, Relevance & Personalization, Trips, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, Legal, and Privacy aligned on shared goals and sequencing
Design A/B experiments and offline evals, including proxy metrics for planning quality and measurement of long-term effects
Turn complex technical tradeoffs into clear decisions for engineering teams and concise narratives for leadership

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Post Sales, Strategic
jobs.blurb: Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk…
jobs.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Solutions Consultant, Post-Sales at Ramp partner with Account Management to deepen and expand relationships with existing Ramp customers. You'll act as the technical and financial subject matter expert across the customer lifecycle — running product demonstrations to expand customers onto new Ramp products, while bringing the depth needed to resolve complex ERP integrations, configuration challenges, and technical blockers.

You'll collaborate closely with Account Managers to assess requirements, design scalable solutions, and ensure fast time-to-value as customers grow with Ramp. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers. This role requires strong technical skills — comfort with APIs, ERP systems, and integration architecture — paired with the communication ability to translate complexity into clear business value for finance and operations stakeholders.

This role is specifically focused on Strategic Enterprise customers, supporting large, complex organizations with multi-entity environments, advanced ERP integrations, and highly customized financial workflows.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Partner with Account Managers to demonstrate new Ramp products and features to existing customers, building the business case for expansion through customized demos and workflow illustrations
Evaluate customer requirements for expansion opportunities, assessing fit through use-case analysis, ROI assessments, and technical scoping
Design and recommend best-fit Ramp architecture — including when and how to use APIs, ERP integrations, and HRIS connectors — based on each customer's existing systems and workflows
Act as a technical advisor to customers and internal teams, guiding integration, configuration, and system design decisions without writing code directly
Troubleshoot ERP and integration blockers, and guide customers through complex configuration decisions across NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle Fusion, and others
Support Account Managers on technical workstreams, ensuring faster time-to-value during product rollouts and expansions
Be a subject matter expert across accounting systems and integration partners; advocate for integration development in line with customer needs alongside Product and Partners
Influence Ramp's product roadmap by channeling customer pain points and feedback to Product and Engineering teams

sections.title: What You Need
bullets: 4+ years in Solutions Consulting, Technical Consulting, Implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role in SaaS or fintech
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, business, or a related field
Hands-on familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle Fusion) and finance/accounting workflows
Comfort with APIs, integration logic, and system architecture — and the ability to explain those concepts clearly to finance and operations stakeholders
Experience running product demonstrations and translating complex technical capabilities into clear business value
Strong communication skills: able to guide customers toward scalable approaches and diplomatically steer conversations when requests are misaligned with product capabilities or best practices
Collaborative mindset; effective working cross-functionally with Account Management, Product, and Engineering
Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments; highly organized, ownership-oriented, and resourceful as Ramp scales its upmarket motion

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp is hiring a Manager, CSM, New Products to build and lead the team that helps customers put our newest products to work. This team supports customers across segments. Its job is to take a new product from sales handoff through implementation, first useful result, and early adoption, then make sure the next owner has a clear path forward.

The products and customer needs will change. You will build a team and an operating rhythm that can change with them. You will coach people with different strengths, help them make good decisions when the playbook is still being written, and turn what we learn from customers into a better way to launch the next one. You will work closely with Sales, core Customer Success, Solutions, Product, and Operations to make the customer experience feel coordinated.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a growing team of Customer Activation Managers. Set a clear bar for customer judgment, implementation ownership, follow-through, and communication.

Give direct, useful feedback through customer-call reviews, case discussions, one-on-ones, and development plans. Help strong individual contributors grow into broader scope and address performance gaps early.

Help the team turn an unclear sales handoff into a customer plan with the right stakeholders, prerequisites, owners, milestones, and first useful outcome. Step in on complex launches and escalations when your judgment will move the work forward.

Build and improve the team's implementation process: assignment and handoff, customer discovery, launch plans, specialist engagement, first-use checks, adoption follow-up, and the transition to ongoing ownership.

Make ownership clear when a customer has both a core Customer Success Manager and a New Products specialist. Keep one customer plan while giving the specialist room to lead the product implementation.

Use customer progress, launch quality, team capacity, and time spent on implementations to spot where customers or team members are getting stuck. Adjust coverage and process based on what the data and customer work show.
Partner with Sales, Product, Solutions, Support, and Customer Success leaders to resolve recurring blockers, set realistic customer expectations, and improve product readiness and the next launch.
Bring early customer patterns back to Product and leadership. Be specific about what customers can do today, what takes specialist help, and what we need to change before the motion scales.

sections.title: What You'll Need
bullets: Either 2+ years directly managing a customer success, implementation, solutions, or consulting team or 6+ years as an individual contributor in one or more of those roles, with clear evidence that you have coached others and led work beyond your own accounts.

A record of taking customers through a complex implementation or workflow change, from discovery and planning to first use and adoption. You know how to tell whether a customer is actually using what was launched.
Experience building or improving a process that other people used, with examples of what you changed after seeing it work in practice.
Strong coaching judgment. You can diagnose whether someone needs clearer expectations, better skills, more support, or a change in approach, and you can give feedback that improves performance.

Comfort making coverage and prioritization decisions with incomplete information. You can balance customer complexity, team capacity, and product readiness without losing sight of the customer's outcome.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Millions of websites, applications, APIs, and AI agents run on Cloudflare, and the traffic we handle for them produces a lot of data. Some customers want to debug applications and investigate security events in Cloudflare. Others want that data in a stack they already trust, such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or their own data lake. Many want both.
We're hiring one Senior Product Manager for each of two areas. You apply once, and we'll work out together which role fits you best.

Observability Platform brings logs, traces, analytics, alerts, and dashboards together in one place, so customers can see what's happening and why. Today most observability ends with a notification, and the customer does the rest. We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Talk with customers every day and deeply understand their needs. They include developers building on Cloudflare, security teams who feed our logs into a SIEM, and platform teams who run OpenTelemetry pipelines.
Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for your area, and make hard trade-offs between speed, retention, reliability, and cost.
Build on open standards like OpenTelemetry, W3C Trace Context, and SQL so teams can keep using the tools they already have.
Own the business, including pricing, packaging, and revenue. Measure progress by adoption and reliability.

sections.title: In Observability Platform , you'll also:
bullets: Bring every Cloudflare product into one observability experience, so customers can follow a problem from one product to the next without switching tools.
Move beyond notifications to workflows that investigate, roll back, or fix problems, with guardrails customers control.
Give people and their agents the context they need to act safely, including how services connect and depend on each other.
Own the experience end to end, from first setup to the middle of an incident or an audit.

sections.title: In Telemetry Export , you'll also:
bullets: Bring Logpush, Workers Logpush, and the OpenTelemetry destinations in Workers Observability together as one product, and keep existing integrations working.
Ship metrics export and extend OTLP delivery to more of our datasets. Own the intake path for telemetry from outside Cloudflare; Observability Platform will store and query it.
Make delivery something customers can trust, so they can see whether their data arrived, get a useful alert when it didn't, and know how to recover.
Help customers filter and transform data before it's sent, so they export only what they need.

We are seeking former sales leaders and founders to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform growth inside a select portfolio of the most important technology companies in the world.

You'll partner with the account team to guide strategic decisions, lead engagement with key executives, and bring developer fluency married to deep business acumen.

sections.title: What You Will Do
bullets: Architect the account strategy. Build and execute a multi-year Developer Platform plan for each account: defining priority workloads, how adoption grows, competitive position, and the commercial path to get there.

Accelerate the customer journey (drive activation → expansion → commercial structure): Use usage telemetry to find next-best actions, expansion paths, and risks. Remove technical, commercial, and organizational blockers so real workloads land and scale.

Structure strategic deals. Work with the account executive, Deal Desk, Pricing, Finance, and Legal to design commit structures and consumption-based agreements that match how the customer actually builds. Compete credibly against hyperscalers and other platforms.

Lead executive engagement. Build trusted relationships with CTOs and heads of infrastructure, AI, and engineering, as well as the commercial decision makers. Run impactful executive business reviews and leverage Cloudflare leadership at the right moments.

Mobilize Cloudflare. Align the account team, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Product, and Support on the account's priorities, establishing clear owners and driving flawless follow-through. Run GTM motions in step with the workloads where we've proven fit.
Close the loop with Product. Turn what you see in the account into clear, quantified recommendations on positioning, packaging, limits, and roadmap.

Elevate the field: Turn your account experience into workload blueprints, deal patterns, and playbooks. Coach sales leaders and account teams in a train-the-trainer model to scale your impact globally..

sections.title: Overview
paras: About the Role - As a Sales Engineer at Instacart, you'll have a unique opportunity to drive adoption of our flagship, industry leading ecommerce products and services directly to the largest retailers in North America and across the globe. This role requires you to lead consultative, technical-focused discussions with external and internal stakeholders, supporting new implementations and integrations. With your expertise, you'll guide customers through the sales cycle, providing both technical and product knowledge. Collaborating with cross-functional teams will give you a holistic understanding of Instacart's technical capabilities.

About the Team - You’ll join our Sales Engineering team, working at the intersection of Business Development, Product, Engineering, and Enterprise Solutions. We collaborate as one team to bring Instacart’s ecosystem to life for partners—aligning technical capabilities with strategic goals, informing product roadmaps with customer insights, and ensuring seamless handoffs into implementation. We value executional excellence, clear communication tailored to diverse audiences, and creative problem-solving that moves the business forward.

sections.title: About the job
bullets: Work closely with Business Development team to develop and implement strategies to influence greater adoption of Instacart products and services

Prepare for and lead technical discussions with teams ranging from executive level business stakeholders to engineers/developers, with the ability to tailor relevant content for the wide range of audience
Gain a deep understand of the ever-changing Instacart eco-system to successfully provide consultative services to partners and business stakeholders
Continually build technical knowledge and capabilities by interfacing with Instacart’s product and engineering teams as you will represent both to customers and business teams
Work directly with various Enterprise Solutions teams to ensure smooth handoff of implementation scope and plans to ensure successful implementations
Define internal processes and requirements to ensure these are accounted for during early stages of scoping
Identify new opportunities from discussions with potential customers and market trends and provide feedback to Product teams to ensure we are building the right products for the market
Create and maintain technical sales material to scale sales process

sections.title: Minimum Qualifications

Strong experiences selling technical products and solutioning/scoping integrations into client’s unique environments
The ability to develop and own technical presentations and communications
Excellent communication skills with the ability to balance complex technical concepts with business values
Some travel required

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

sections.title: The Community You Will Join
paras: Every day, Airbnb hosts provide unique Stays and Experiences that connect guests with local communities in authentic and meaningful ways. These offerings are the core of what makes Airbnb special, creating connections and unforgettable memories for travelers worldwide.

The Enterprise Account team represents the largest and most strategic supply partnerships within Airbnb and plays a vital role in growing the business. This role goes far beyond traditional account management.

sections.title: The Difference You Will Make
paras: As an Enterprise Account Lead, you will own the commercial performance of Airbnb’s largest property commercial partners. You will design and cultivate strong, collaborative relationships to shape their strategic roadmap, negotiate commercial terms, and optimize their listings at scale so Airbnb is competitive and the preferred distribution partner.

You will own the end to end full relationship and commercial growth of C-Suite partners. You will shape the strategy for how these partners perform on Airbnb, driving outcomes that matter for hosts, guests, and Airbnb's business.

sections.title: A Typical Day
bullets: Act as a strategic partner to relevant stakeholders to inform Airbnb enterprise account strategy, and communicate impact to relevant teams clearly
Partner and influence key internal leaders on their roadmaps, ensure their teams support these key partnerships, and unlock revenue through product and policy enhancements
Build and maintain trusted relationships with founders, board members, and executive stakeholders from partner accounts
Navigate complex commercial conversations — multi-stakeholder deals, evolving usage patterns, and competitive evaluations in partnership with internal stakeholders
Serve as the voice of the customer by gathering feedback and conveying market needs to inform our product roadmap
Proactively identify and mitigate retention and competitive risks while maintaining high customer satisfaction
Own and influence the business outcomes for assigned high valued accounts, strategically planning for the next phases of commercial growth
Have a deep understanding of Airbnb policy, processes, and procedures to provide strategic decisions to (balancing long term success of Airbnb and our partners)

sections.title: Required qualifications
bullets: 10+ years of experience leading business development, account management, business operations, or partnership initiative with large enterprise clients.
Experience analyzing, structuring, and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business units.
Experience developing and selling complex business solutions at the C suite level.
Ability to analyze data to uncover trends and inform decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to travel at least 30% of the time for client and internal meetings.
Track record of setting strategy and delivering measurable results.
Comfort negotiating commercial deals that balance short term needs and long term implications.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Strategic
jobs.blurb: Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk…
jobs.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the team and role
paras: Ramp’s Strategic Lifecycle Success team helps our largest and most complex customers turn their investment in Ramp into lasting business impact. After initial onboarding and implementation are complete, we help customers deepen adoption, continuously improve their Ramp setup, and successfully launch and activate additional products as their needs evolve.

As a Strategic Lifecycle Customer Success Manager, you’ll be a hands-on product expert and trusted partner to the finance, accounting, and operations teams using Ramp. You’ll own the ongoing customer success plan, proactively improve workflows, and lead onboarding and implementation when existing customers adopt new Ramp products. You’ll also lead adoption and value-focused business reviews, connecting how customers use Ramp to the outcomes that matter to their business.

You’ll work alongside an Account Manager, who owns commercial strategy and executive relationships, and partner with Solutions Consultants and Technical Consultants on complex technical needs. Your focus is helping customers get more from Ramp over time—from optimizing what’s already live to making each new product rollout successful.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Own ongoing success planning for a portfolio of customers. After a structured handoff from initial onboarding and implementation, partner with a dedicated Account Manager to align on customer goals and define clear milestones, owners, and measures of success.
Serve as a trusted Ramp product expert. Stay current on new products, capabilities, and best practices, and proactively translate relevant releases into recommendations for each customer.

Continuously enhance customers’ Ramp environments. Understand their configuration and business processes, identify opportunities to improve policies, controls, approval flows, and workflows, and work hands-on with customers to put those improvements into practice.

Manage customer health proactively. Monitor adoption, engagement, outcomes, and delivery risks; identify barriers early; and lead action plans to improve customer health. Equip your Account Manager with value evidence for renewal and growth conversations.

sections.title: What you need
bullets: A track record in enterprise customer success, including hands-on ownership of implementation, adoption, and ongoing value realization for complex customers.
Strong product aptitude and experience configuring and optimizing software to support customer business processes—not just advising from a distance.
Experience managing customer-facing implementations, from discovery and project planning through training, launch, and sustained adoption.
The ability to lead business reviews that connect product usage to financial and operational outcomes, such as stronger controls, more efficient workflows, greater visibility, and time saved.
Practical AI fluency: experience using AI tools to synthesize account information, prepare customer materials, and improve your work, with sound judgment about accuracy and appropriate use.

sections.title: Overview
paras: The Customer Success team partners with our CPG customers to drive value creation and satisfaction with Eversight's pioneering SaaS solutions. The Customer Success Senior Associate supports the complete customer journey. This includes onboarding clients, guiding them through the micro-testing and data mining process to generate valuable insights from our platforms, delivering impactful software demonstrations and trainings, and partnering closely with Product and Engineering to identify product bugs and enhancement opportunities. The ultimate goal is to help customers roll out optimal promotions and topline revenue driving strategies at scale. This is an opportunity to experience first-hand the excitement and challenge of introducing novel and demonstrably superior capabilities to transform the market.

Eversight by Instacart is Instacart's data and SaaS organization and recognized leader in AI-powered promotion optimization and insights. Global brands and retailers rely on the Eversight platform to optimize promotional strategies in response to market conditions and to deliver higher ROI on promotional spend. Eversight by Instacart's Data Solutions are driving strong margin and sales volume improvements for leading companies such as Coca-Cola, Frito-Lay, Haleon, and more. Eversight was founded in 2013 and acquired by Instacart in 2022.

sections.title: About the Job
bullets: Forge and nurture strong relationships with key customer stakeholders, including power users and program managers.
Serve as the subject matter expert for customers, providing guidance to help them maximize Eversight's innovative capabilities.
Work directly with customers to implement promotional strategies and insights that deliver transformative outcomes.
Deliver a high-quality customer experience through strong project management, ensuring timely outputs and proactively addressing bottlenecks.
Manage multiple data-driven processes and schedules while maintaining a high standard of execution.
Standardize customer support materials and processes to improve scalability.
Represent the "voice of the customer" internally, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to recommend improvements and add new capabilities.

sections.title: Minimum Qualifications
bullets: You have 3+ years of work experience, ideally in a customer-facing or commercial role.
Direct experience with CPG a plus.
You have a Bachelor's degree, ideally with a business degree or in a quantitative field.

You have strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, and complex formulas). You’re comfortable using AI tools as a thought partner to sharpen client deliverables, while the core thinking and the work itself stay your own.
You're passionate about working directly with customers and excelling at relationship-building; experience in customer-facing or cross-functional roles is a plus.
You excel at managing multiple workstreams independently, have high attention to detail, and proactively recognize and address challenges.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfillment
jobs.blurb: The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people.…
jobs.summary:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: As a Senior Product Manager on Flexport's Warehouse Management System (WMS), you will own the software that runs work inside the warehouses fulfilling orders for Flexport merchants. You will set the product vision for your area of a modern, scalable WMS and partner with engineering, design, warehouse operations, and business teams to ship it. Your work shapes how fast, accurate, and cost-efficient fulfillment is for merchants of every size.

sections.title: Omnichannel Fulfillment at Flexport
paras: Omnichannel fulfillment sits at the heart of Flexport's mission to make global commerce so easy that there would be more of it. By integrating logistics across e-commerce, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels, we help merchants deliver faster, more efficiently, and at lower cost. The WMS is the execution layer underneath all of it: it turns merchant orders and inventory into physical work on the warehouse floor. Learn more about Flexport Omnichannel here .

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Lead product strategy for your WMS area: Define the vision, goals, and roadmap for the warehouse execution capabilities you own, in line with the broader WMS and Omnichannel strategy.
Own the product lifecycle: Drive features from discovery and BRDs through launch and iteration, tying each to merchant and business outcomes.

Drive platform evolution: Contribute to the migration and consolidation of warehouse systems onto Flexport's WMS, including regression testing, cutover planning, and risk management with warehouse partners.
Partner with warehouse operations: Work with operations and site teams to turn floor-level workflows, constraints, and exceptions into scalable product capabilities.

Partner cross-functionally: Align engineering, design, data science, and adjacent product teams (inventory, inbounds, outbounds, returns, merchant APIs and reporting) on priorities and integration points.
Champion customer and operator insight: Gather feedback from merchants, warehouse associates, and operations leaders to guide prioritization.
Communicate with leadership: Report progress, trade-offs, and risks to senior leaders across Flexport and key customers.
Measure and iterate: Define and track metrics for your area, such as cycle time, accuracy, throughput, and cost per order.

sections.title: What You Bring
bullets: 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of launching and scaling complex, high-impact products.
Hands-on experience with WMS, fulfillment, or supply chain execution systems, and a working grasp of warehouse workflows such as receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and inventory control.
Experience leading large system migrations or platform replacements, from planning and testing through cutover.
Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional teams, including engineering and operations, delivering complex projects from concept to execution.
Strong prioritization and the ability to frame trade-offs in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Exceptional communication: you influence without authority and build trust with stakeholders from the warehouse floor to the executive team.
Strong writing skills to communicate vision, roadmap, requirements, launches, and impact to a broad audience.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Every business pays bills, and many of them still do it by hand. Someone opens the invoice, types it in, codes it, chases approvals, pays it, matches it and syncs it to the books. It's one of the largest manual workflows left in finance.

We're building the version where software does that work. Bills come in and get read, coded, matched, approved and paid, and a person steps in only when judgment matters. Bill Pay is already one of Ramp's fastest-growing products. The next few years decide who owns AP for the next decade, and we plan for it to be us.
We're looking for a PM who wants to build that.
bullets: Please note that this role requires in-person presence at our NYC or SF office at least 2 days/week.
Level will be determined based on the candidate’s interview performance and previous scope of responsibility.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own strategy, roadmap and results for a major part of Bill Pay.
Spend real time with AP clerks, controllers and CFOs, and turn what you see into product.
Prototype with customers, set quality bars with Engineering and Data, and ship automation people trust.
Measure success by adoption, automation and time saved, then use the data to decide what comes next.
Work with Procurement, Accounting, Payments and Risk so a bill moves from inbox to payment to the books without gaps.

sections.title: Problems you'll work on
bullets: How do we get from "AI drafts the bill" to "AI handles the bill" without customers losing trust or control?
When should an agent act on its own, when should it ask, and how do we show our work so a controller signs off with confidence?
How do we make one product that a 10-person startup sets up in minutes and a multi-entity enterprise with an ERP and an AP team runs at scale?
How do we catch the wrong bill, the duplicate and the suspicious vendor change before the money leaves?
How do we use what Ramp knows across millions of transactions to help customers pay smarter, not just faster?

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp's Mid-Market Customer Success Managers on the Lifecycle team don't stop at go-live — they make sure customers keep getting more from Ramp as their business grows. As we've matured as an organization, our customer relationships have grown more complex too: customers are buying more of the platform at once, running it across more entities and teams, and relying on it for more of how their finance function operates. Hitting an activation milestone doesn't mean the job's finished. This is a role for people who understand how finance teams actually run, who think in years rather than quarters, and who already use AI the way surgeons use instruments: not occasionally, not as an experiment, but as the default way they work. You'll own the customer experience after implementation for a book of mid-market customers, partnering with Account Management on long-term account strategy. Drive sustained adoption by understanding each customer's goals and guiding them toward the workflows that improve outcomes for their business — including the products and features they've already purchased but haven't fully put to work

Act as each customer's expert in finance workflows: understand how they run their business, advise on decisions as their needs change, and make the value of new Ramp capabilities clear in their context
Build multi-threaded relationships in every account, including finance leadership relationships you own, so the account stays steady through change like a new Controller or CFO

Spot opportunities for growth and bring them to Account Management, who owns renewals and expansion; as customers add products, drive ongoing activation so they reach value quickly
Run your book on data: monitor usage, CP, and risk signals, prioritize where your time goes, and get ahead of challenges and escalations before they reach renewal
Use AI tools daily to prepare for customer calls, build materials, synthesize data, identify account risk, and operate at a pace traditional methods can't match

jobs.summary: At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Cloudflare's developer platform lets developers build full-stack applications that run on a global network. Alongside Workers, developers rely on a growing set of data products: D1 for serverless SQLite, Durable Objects for stateful coordination, KV for global key-value storage, R2 for object storage, and Hyperdrive for connecting to existing databases.

This role will be leading a new database product from its earliest days. You will define what the product is, who it is for, and why developers should choose it over the databases they already know. Then you will get it to first customers and see it through to general availability.
Your mission in this role is to lead the project of building a database designed for agent-driven development workflows, getting both the core tradeoffs and the fine-grained details right.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Run customer discovery to find and sharpen the problem the product should solve.
Define the product, its target users, and its positioning against established databases.
Work with engineering on core design tradeoffs across consistency, latency, scale, durability, and cost to serve.
Recruit design partners and run a private beta that produces honest, usable feedback.
Set success metrics and use them to decide what to build, change, or cut.
Own pricing and packaging, grounded in customer value and unit economics.
Drive the product from first prototype through beta, launch, and GA.
Make sure it fits naturally with Workers, Wrangler, and Cloudflare's existing data products.

Real experience building on databases. You have modeled data, written queries, and run SQL or NoSQL databases in production.
Solid grasp of distributed-systems tradeoffs. You can reason through replication, consistency models, and failure modes with engineers.
Comfort with pricing and unit economics for infrastructure. You know what a workload costs to serve and how that shapes a price.
Deep empathy for developers and how they choose and adopt new platforms. You understand what it's like to bet your application on a database someone else built.
Hands-on ability to write code and use AI and the Internet to learn new things fast.
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills. You can translate between engineering domains and align diverse teams on goals.

Experiment design, automation measurement, or evaluation of changes to customer workflows
Deeper financial modeling, workforce planning, or coaching other analysts
Experience designing in Figma

Build and deliver compelling proofs-of-concept and live demos on the Databricks Platform that drive technical wins
Own frontline technical relationships with customer engineers, data teams, and technical leads
Develop account-level technical strategies in partnership with your Account Executive to grow platform consumption
Navigate competitive landscapes by articulating Databricks differentiation through hands-on demonstrations
Contribute reusable technical assets (notebooks, solution accelerators, reference architectures) to the broader SA community

Hands-on experience designing and implementing data solutions on at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Working knowledge of distributed data systems: Apache Spark™, Delta Lake, or equivalent (Hadoop, Kafka, Flink)
Experience leading technical customer conversations — discovery, whiteboarding, architecture reviews
Familiarity with one or more: data engineering (ETL/ELT, medallion architecture, streaming), data science/ML (model training, MLOps), or SQL analytics
Strong presentation and demo skills — you will build and present a live solution during the interview
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)

Experience with Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines, or MLflow
Background at a data/AI company, cloud provider, or technical consulting firm

jobs.title: Director, Customer Success, Government
jobs.blurb: Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a…
jobs.summary:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company .

sections.title: About the team/role
paras: Checkr's Government business helps state, federal and local government agencies verify income, employment and assets for the programs they run. As Director of Customer Success, Government, you will own the health, adoption and renewal of our agency portfolio and build the team that supports it. You will lead a team of 3 Customer Success Managers and work alongside our Solutions Architects, Sales and Product teams. This role reports to the VP of Government, with a dotted line to Checkr's Customer Success organization.

This is a data-driven role. You will use data to understand how each agency uses our products, find opportunities to deliver more value, and turn those insights into clear plans that agencies and their partners act on. You will be the senior relationship for agency leaders across program, operations and technology teams, and the trusted advisor they call when something needs to change. You will be accountable for customer retention, renewals and growth across your portfolio.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Own portfolio health and renewals: Run an account plan for every agency with clear goals for adoption and value delivered. Spot renewal risk early and lead renewals through to contract, working with Sales and agency procurement.

Drive adoption with data: Interpret the weekly performance reporting our team prepares for each customer, and challenge it where it doesn't add up. Identify where usage and outcomes can improve, size the opportunity, and turn it into specific recommendations agencies can act on.

Build trusted agency relationships: Be the executive point of contact for program, eligibility, policy and IT leaders, and for the systems integrators and technology partners that support them. Lead business reviews that agencies use to make decisions, not just to receive updates.
Grow the accounts we have: Partner with Sales to identify and pursue expansion into new programs, products and agencies.

Lead and develop the team: Recruit, coach and manage a team of Customer Success Managers. Set the standard for account plans, business reviews and escalations, and give the team the tools to run a growing portfolio.

Represent the agency inside Checkr: Work with Product, Engineering, Solutions and Support to prioritize what agencies need, from user experience and accessibility to security, compliance and reporting requirements.
Build the operating model: Define the playbooks, health scores and metrics the team runs on, and keep them simple enough to use every week.

sections.title: What a typical week looks like
bullets: Review the weekly performance reporting for each agency with your team: usage, where applicants drop off, and how each agency compares with its peers.
Work out what is driving each change, and separate real shifts in performance from changes in how a number is measured.
Turn that analysis into a short list of recommendations and agree who owns each one: the agency, its integrator or Checkr.
Prepare and lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with agency leaders, and follow up until the agreed changes are in place.
Track open implementation and support issues with Solutions Architects, and escalate whatever is blocking an agency.
Coach your Customer Success Managers on account plans and agency conversations, and review renewal and expansion plans with Sales.

sections.title: What you bring
bullets: Agency experience (required): Direct experience working with state government agencies, whether inside an agency, at a systems integrator, or at a vendor serving them. Familiarity with government eligibility and verification requirements, public-sector procurement, and government security standards such as FedRAMP or StateRAMP.
Experience and leadership: At least 10 years in Customer Success, Account Management, consulting or related roles, with at least 6 years leading teams.

Analytical depth: You work directly with data in SQL, spreadsheets or BI tools, and you are comfortable with funnel analysis, benchmarking across customers and unit economics. You can explain why a metric moved, notice when a change reflects how it is measured rather than real performance, and use that analysis to decide what to do next.

Relationship building: A record of trusted, long-term relationships with senior agency leaders and integrator partners. You are patient through long public-sector cycles and direct in difficult conversations.
Communication: Clear written and verbal communication. You can turn data into a recommendation and adapt it for executives, frontline staff and technical teams.
Integrity: Known for candor, transparency and treating everyone with respect, including the people whose data we handle.
Willingness to travel: Ability to travel domestically up to 25% for agency onsites, business reviews, conferences and team meetings.
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

jobs.title: Lead CX Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.blurb: At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more…
jobs.summary:
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

sections.title: About Gusto
paras: AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: Gusto's Customer Experience team is changing how we serve small businesses: new service models, a telephony platform migration, and the data infrastructure to support both. We are hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst to own the data layer that makes this work.

You will work directly with CX leaders to identify and scope priorities, own the foundation of pipelines, data models, and dashboards that make CX data trustworthy, and use that foundation to answer causal questions about what actually moves customer outcomes. The strongest candidates pair real coding and statistical depth with the judgment to know which question is worth answering.

sections.title: About the Team:
paras: CX Data and Insights is the analytical backbone of Gusto's Customer Experience organization. We define the metrics CX leaders run the business on, and we produce the analysis that shapes operational roadmap decisions.

sections.title: Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:
bullets: Lead: Own ambiguous problems, design analysis and measurement frameworks, and introduce policies and practices by which data integrity is monitored and enforced within your domain.
Execution: Deliver multiple high-impact projects, balancing trade-offs to maximize business value, and maintain clear expectations of deliverables and timelines.
Strategic Partnership: Partner with CX leaders, cross-function data-science teams, tool developers (i.e. Salesforce), and data engineering to align on strategy.

Develop and scale reporting: Define DBT and Snowflake data pipeline requirements for evolving CX data sources, build and maintain monitoring systems, and streamline dashboards for day-to-day operation and self-serve insights.
Independence: Independently determines analytical research, metrics and/or data products to achieve annual objectives, and proactively resolving conflicts or misalignment across stakeholders.

Scale the Craft: Up-level the team’s best practices in data modeling and schema design, expand our toolsets (e.g., Databricks for AI-augmented modeling and anomaly detection) where they accelerate CX outcomes, drive improvements in data quality, rigor, and adoption of better data capabilities, and mentor other data practitioners.
Communication: Present complex findings in a structured, compelling way to technical and non-technical stakeholders, fostering a data-informed mindset across the company.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Instacart Business - Growth
jobs.blurb: At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless…
jobs.summary:
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

sections.title: Instacart is a Flex First team
paras: There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

sections.title: Overview
paras: Instacart Business is hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive growth on Instacart Business. You'll own how we acquire, activate, retain, and expand business customers across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: You'll own the growth roadmap end to end. That means setting the goals, sizing the opportunities, running the experiments, and deciding what to scale and what to kill. We're focused on durable growth: compounding levers that keep businesses ordering and grow their accounts over time.

Instacart Business's features are one of your biggest levers. Team accounts, spending controls, invoicing, tax-exempt purchasing, and integrations are what we lead with when we acquire customers, what we activate them into, and what makes Instacart Business part of how they run. Driving adoption of those features is a dedicated growth initiative. You'll also spot where new or expanded features can open up more growth.

The role suits a PM who knows funnel metrics and experimentation well, and who has the product craft to turn what they learn into better experiences. You'll bring your own point of view on where growth comes from, and you'll align Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Design, Engineering, and Data Science behind it.

sections.title: About the Team
paras: Instacart Business brings Instacart's same-day delivery to companies of every size, from small offices and restaurants to large enterprises. Our customers use it for office snacks and supplies, team events, restaurant restocking, and everything in between. We build for how businesses buy. That means shared accounts with team management, spending controls and approvals, tax-exempt purchasing, invoicing and net terms, and integrations with the expense and procurement tools businesses already use. These features are available in the Instacart app and on the e-commerce sites Instacart powers for retailers.
Many businesses already shop on Instacart outside of Instacart Business. You'll convert them into Instacart Business customers and grow the accounts we already have.

Growth sits within the product team. You'll work alongside the PMs building payments, invoicing, and integrations. We're a small team with a high bar for craft and a bias toward shipping, measuring, and learning fast.
