jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing
jobs.blurb: Spotify is shaping the future of advertising by connecting brands with fans through audio, video, and experiences that are part of people's everyday lives. As our advertising business grows, we're focused on bringing innovative products to market, helping…
jobs.summary:
Spotify is shaping the future of advertising by connecting brands with fans through audio, video, and experiences that are part of people's everyday lives. As our advertising business grows, we're focused on bringing innovative products to market, helping advertisers succeed, and turning new ideas into meaningful business growth.

We're looking for a Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing to lead the next chapter of our global Advertising Product Marketing team. Reporting to the Head of Advertising Business Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to shape product strategy, strengthen our market position, and help advertisers get more value from Spotify.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for global Advertising Product Marketing, connecting advertiser needs, product innovation, competitive insights, and business growth.

Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to bring customer and market insights into product decisions and turn innovation into solutions advertisers value.

Lead global go-to-market strategies for Spotify's advertising products, including brand and performance advertising, self-service, programmatic, and emerging solutions. Own product positioning, messaging, packaging, launches, and adoption.

Build a deeper understanding of advertisers, agencies, buying behaviors, and the competitive landscape. Use these insights to identify opportunities, influence product priorities, and strengthen Spotify's position in the market.

Drive product adoption and commercial growth by identifying customer needs, addressing barriers to adoption, and partnering with teams to improve product usage, retention, and revenue. Define clear measures of success and use results to guide future decisions.

Turn complex advertising technology, data, and measurement capabilities into clear, differentiated customer value propositions tied to measurable business outcomes. Partner with Business Marketing to create a consistent story across products and help advertisers understand the impact Spotify can deliver.

Strengthen how products move from development to market. Establish clear processes, shared accountability, and measures of readiness that help teams make informed decisions about when to launch, scale, improve, or stop initiatives.
Equip Sales and regional teams with the insights, messaging, and tools they need to bring Spotify's advertising solutions to customers.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: You have 15+ years of experience
You have built, scaled or transformed Product Marketing organizations in advertising technology, digital advertising or a related platform business.
You have led global teams across complex product portfolios, shaped product strategy and delivered business results.
You understand how advertising businesses grow, including advertiser and agency needs, programmatic buying, self-service platforms, brand and performance advertising, and measurement.
You have experience shaping product strategy and leading go-to-market initiatives across complex product portfolios, translating customer insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
You are an influential executive communicator who engages credibly with senior Product, Engineering, and Commercial leaders, as well as externally with clients and partners.

You combine strategic thinking with strong commercial judgment. You're comfortable using customer research, competitive insights, and performance data to make decisions, identify opportunities, and measure success.
You can explain complex technology in clear, engaging ways and communicate effectively with senior leaders, advertisers, agencies, and business partners.

sections.title: Where You'll Be
bullets: This role is based in New York.
We ask that you come into the office 2–3 times per week.

jobs.title: VP, Head of Product - Advertising
jobs.blurb: Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds…
jobs.summary:
Spotify has the opportunity to build one of the world's most distinctive advertising businesses at the intersection of audio, video, display, and creator culture, powered by deep audience insights and a global platform reaching hundreds of millions of people.

We're looking for a VP, Head of Product, Advertising to help define what advertising on Spotify becomes. Building on the transformation of our advertising platform, you'll shape the next generation of advertising products and experiences, how brands connect with audiences, and unlock new opportunities for growth. You'll balance strengthening and scaling our core platform with creating entirely new products, capabilities, and business opportunities that differentiate Spotify in the market.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Champion the customer and represent our vision. Ground the product organization in advertiser and agency needs, market dynamics, and customer insights. Communicate a compelling strategy to senior leadership, advertisers, agencies, and partners.

Connect product to business outcomes. Partner with Engineering, Commercial, and Business Development leadership to improve advertiser adoption, campaign performance, monetization, and long-term growth — evaluating build-versus-partner opportunities and translating strategic relationships into scalable capabilities.
Build an exceptional organization. Attract, develop, and lead a high-performing global Product and Design team, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and strong execution.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: You are an accomplished product executive with 15+ years of experience defining and scaling sophisticated technology products, including 5+ years leading large, multilayered Product organizations.
You bring deep advertising technology expertise, ideally spanning programmatic advertising, auctions, self-service, targeting, optimization, measurement, and monetization.

You have personally led meaningful product or business transformations — not simply extending an existing roadmap, but fundamentally reshaping product strategy, go-to-market approach, or business model to drive step-change growth and competitive differentiation.
You have a demonstrated track record of building products that drive meaningful customer adoption, business growth, and competitive differentiation.
You combine strategic imagination with exceptional product judgment and the ability to make difficult investment tradeoffs.
You are forward-thinking about AI and emerging technologies and can translate technological change into compelling customer experiences and new business opportunities.
You understand how advertisers and agencies make investment decisions and can connect customer needs with product strategy and commercial outcomes.
You have successfully built, scaled, and transformed large, multidisciplinary Product and Design organizations, attracting exceptional talent and developing strong senior leaders.

sections.title: Where You'll Be
paras: The United States base range for this position is $373,310 to $533,300 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
bullets: New York is the preferred location for this role.
We are open to considering exceptional candidates based elsewhere, with the expectation of 30% travel to support leadership collaboration, customer engagement, and business priorities.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Lead, Strategic Programs
jobs.blurb: Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk…
jobs.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp’s Enterprise Marketing team helps win and grow our largest accounts. Across ABM, Product Marketing and Customer Marketing, we shape how Ramp shows up for enterprise buyers, create campaigns that open doors, and equip Sales with the positioning and customer proof to move deals forward. Our customer programs deepen those relationships through peer connections, executive engagement and partnerships that create value for customers and new opportunities for Ramp.

You’ll own a portfolio spanning our Customer Advisory Board, co-marketing programs, and reference programs and quarterly Know Your Customer program. You’ll build trusted relationships with CFOs, senior finance leadership, and customers’ Communications and Marketing teams, creating opportunities that are valuable to both the customer and Ramp.

This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership. You’ll set program plans, prioritize competing requests, and build the playbooks and systems that keep customer engagement coordinated. You should know when to make an ask, when to change it, and when to hold off. Customer trust and operational rigor matter equally.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own the planning and execution of Ramp’s customer programs, including the calendar, goals, cross-functional responsibilities, and results.
Lead Ramp’s Customer Advisory Board, recruiting members, developing programming and building relationships that deepen customer engagement and advocacy.
Run the Know Your Customer program, helping Ramp employees get to know our customers’ businesses by recruiting participating customers and coordinating employee engagement and communications.

Develop customer launch and co-marketing programs. Work with customers’ executive, Communications, and Marketing teams to shape the partnership. Secure customer participation and approvals, and coordinate delivery of agreed content and campaigns with Creative and Customer Marketing.
Build and scale customer reference and advocacy programs, creating the systems that connect the right customers to relevant sales and marketing opportunities.
Partner closely with Events to recruit and prepare customer speakers for Ramp events, conferences, and executive forums.
Coordinate customer participation in the Times Square billboard and help customers make use of that visibility.

Coordinate customer asks across Sales, account teams, PMM, Comms, Events, and Customer Marketing. Maintain a shared record of commitments, approvals, and recent participation to prevent overlapping outreach and follow through on what we promise customers.

sections.title: What You Need
bullets: You’ve built or significantly scaled customer programs at a high-growth B2B company, including personally recruiting, hosting and maintaining relationships with senior customer leaders.
You’re credible with Fortune 500 C-suite and VP-level customers and comfortable working directly with GTM and company leadership.
You’re comfortable owning a number. You can set goals, report on coverage and engagement, and explain how customer participation supports pipeline or expansion using a defensible methodology.
Strong cross-functional partnership with PMM, Events, Creative, Sales, account teams, and Growth Marketing, including aligning responsibilities and resolving competing customer requests.
The ability to set direction and personally manage execution against programs objectives.
Clear written and verbal communication; you can brief an executive in three bullets and write the memo behind it.
AI fluency and practical automation skills that reduce manual work while maintaining sound judgment, accurate records, and customer trust.
Systems thinking: experience building intake, readiness and permission standards, workflows, and reporting that other teams actually use.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Solutions Consultants, Post-Sales at Ramp partner with Account Management to deepen and expand relationships with existing Ramp customers. You'll act as the technical and financial subject matter expert across the customer lifecycle — running product demonstrations to expand customers onto new Ramp products, while bringing the depth needed to resolve complex ERP integrations, configuration challenges, and technical blockers.

You'll collaborate closely with Account Managers to assess requirements, design scalable solutions, and ensure fast time-to-value as customers grow with Ramp. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers. This role requires strong technical skills — comfort with APIs, ERP systems, and integration architecture — paired with the communication ability to translate complexity into clear business value for finance and operations stakeholders.
This role is focused on Commercial and Mid-Market customers, supporting high-growth companies with standardized financial workflows and core ERP integrations.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Partner with Account Managers to demonstrate new Ramp products and features to existing customers, building the business case for expansion through customized demos and workflow illustrations
Evaluate customer requirements for expansion opportunities, assessing fit through use-case analysis, ROI assessments, and technical scoping
Design and recommend best-fit Ramp architecture — including when and how to use APIs, ERP integrations, and HRIS connectors — based on each customer's existing systems and workflows
Act as a technical advisor to customers and internal teams, guiding integration, configuration, and system design decisions without writing code directly
Troubleshoot ERP and integration blockers, and guide customers through complex configuration decisions across NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle Fusion, and others

sections.title: About Vanta
paras: We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.summary: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

sections.title: The Community You Will Join
paras: The Enterprise Operations organization is instrumental in powering Airbnb's growth and expansion at a global scale. Through AI- and people-powered operations, this team maximizes the effectiveness, utilization, and impact of our supply, ensuring hosts and guests can seamlessly connect.

The Supply Enablement & Activation team is a horizontal Center of Excellence within Enterprise Operations, serving as a strategic partner to global field and vendor teams by driving standardized strategy, tools, and best practices at scale. We turn our supply strategy into repeatable, scalable, best in class enablement deliverables – collateral, training, tools & workflows, and comms/change management -- for our sales & operator teams across each line of business: Homes, Hotels, Experiences & Services.

This role supports the API team, which sits at the heart of Airbnb's Supply strategy, managing the connectivity partners — property management software providers, channel managers, and distribution platforms — that power a significant share of our global inventory. These partnerships unlock access to millions of listings and directly shape the quality and reliability of the host and guest experience.

sections.title: The Difference You Will Make
paras: We're looking for a seasoned Senior Enablement Manager to build and own end-to-end enablement for Airbnb's API team and Connectivity Partner Managers across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. This is a newly approved, full-time role created to close a resourcing gap: enablement support for API has historically been covered informally and part-time, and this role will stand up a sustainable, scalable enablement function from the ground up.

The core of this role is to enable our Connectivity Partner Managers to do their jobs more effectively and drive tangible impact. Connectivity Partner Managers own the full relationship with PMS, channel manager, and revenue management tool partners — from onboarding and integration standards to sync/data issue resolution, contract negotiation, API adoption, and roadmap prioritization with Product and Engineering. You will build the onboarding curriculum, training, playbooks, and certifications that ramp new Connectivity Partner Managers; keep them current on product launches, API versions, and roadmap changes; and equip them with the narratives, tools, and processes they need to manage partner relationships and escalations with confidence.

This is a highly cross-functional, more technical role than a typical field-enablement position — it requires deep, ongoing engagement with the Product roadmap and with Connectivity Partner Managers themselves, not a copy-paste of a direct-sales enablement playbook. You will own onboarding, training, and continuous development for teams supporting API partners; drive consistent acquisition, growth, and retention of high-quality supply; and localize global enablement programs for regional relevance. You'll partner cross-functionally to collect and share feedback, and use enablement tools and insights to continuously improve outcomes.

sections.title: A Typical Day
bullets: Own end-to-end onboarding and ongoing enablement for Connectivity Partner Managers, Enterprise Account Managers and the broader API Product and Enterprise teams globally across AMER, EMEA, and APAC

Build the ramp curriculum, playbooks, and certifications that get new Connectivity Partner Managers and Enterprise Account Managers up to speed on connectivity standards, partner onboarding, sync/data issue resolution, and negotiation processes

Partner closely with the API Product team to translate roadmap priorities, new launches, and GTM initiatives into enablement content and training for Connectivity Partner Managers so they are fully equipped with managing partners effectively and shaping their behaviour
Revive and scale partner-facing enablement channels, including webinars/webcasts on product releases and API versions, and enablement newsletters and comms
Localize global enablement content, sales pitches, and narratives to reflect regional market needs
Design and deliver role-based training programs and playbooks, for Connectivity Partner Management and Homes Enterprise Account Manager teams.
Partner closely with Product, Sales, RevOps, Policy, and regional leaders to align enablement with business priorities
Drive adoption of enablement tools (e.g., Highspot, Gong) and translate insights into actionable coaching and performance improvements

sections.title: An overview of this role
paras: As a Senior Professional Services Engineer at GitLab, you'll work directly with customers to deliver installation, migration, training, and advisory services that help them adopt GitLab successfully. You'll lead engagements from single-node Omnibus installs to large reference architectures built with infrastructure as code (IaC) and configuration as code. You'll also guide migrations from other systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed deployments, and help customers make practical decisions that improve reliability, security, and day-to-day workflows.

In this role, you'll work closely with customers and GitLab's product and engineering teams to drive customer success and share feedback that improves GitLab and how we deliver services. You'll manage multiple projects at once, mentor other Professional Services Engineers, and help streamline how we deliver consistent outcomes in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.
bullets: Designing and delivering GitLab installations and reference architectures using tools like Terraform and Ansible across major cloud providers
Leading migrations to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, and turning customer feedback into actionable improvements for GitLab's product and engineering teams

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Deliver GitLab Professional Services engagements, including installation, migration, training, and advisory services across GitLab capabilities.
Plan and execute deployments ranging from single-node Omnibus installations to large reference architectures using Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code practices.
Lead migrations from multiple source systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, helping customers adopt secure, reliable workflows.
Partner with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to improve delivery consistency, remove friction, and continuously refine delivery processes.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor for customers, translating goals and constraints into practical implementation plans and clear next steps.
Interface with GitLab's product and engineering teams to unblock customer outcomes and share feedback that helps improve GitLab features and services.
Mentor Associate and Intermediate Professional Services Engineers, providing technical guidance, helping remove blockers, and supporting increased autonomy.
Manage and deliver multiple customer engagements at once, either as the primary engineer or as a lead providing oversight and direction to other engineers.

bullets: Professional exposure with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef.
Professional exposure with two or more cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure.
This role has a location requirement - Charlotte, NC or nearby - on site at the Customer location in Charlotte, 5 days a week.

Experience delivering customer-facing services such as installation, migration, training, and advisory engagements across GitLab's feature set.
Proven ability to independently manage one or more projects and to lead and provide direction to other Professional Services Engineers on complex engagements.

Strong communication skills in English, written and verbal, with the ability to provide clear status updates and build consensus with peers and customers in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.

Demonstrated ability to take a solution-oriented approach by identifying root causes, proposing options and tradeoffs, and driving issues to resolution while balancing multiple customer engagements in a fast-paced environment.

sections.title: About the team
paras: Senior Professional Services Engineers are part of GitLab's Professional Services team. We partner closely with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to deliver consistent outcomes, and we work with GitLab's product and engineering teams to share customer feedback and improve GitLab. Professional Services operates in a fully remote and largely asynchronous environment, collaborating across regions and time zones. sections.title: About the role:

jobs.title: Partner Manager, Franchise
jobs.blurb: At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more…
jobs.summary:
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

sections.title: About Gusto
paras: AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: Franchise is one of Gusto's fastest-growing partner channels, and we are looking for a Partner Manager to own it. You will recruit and sign franchisors, and manage the partnerships once they are signed. When a franchisor becomes a Gusto partner, the franchisees in its network can access Gusto's payroll, benefits, and HR platform on partner terms. Franchisors are not traditional channel partners. They protect their brand, support independent owner-operators, and operate within legal limits on how they can endorse vendors. A signed agreement does not guarantee franchisee adoption. Your job is to make Gusto easy for a franchisor to approve and recommend, and to give franchisees a clear reason to choose us. You will own the full partnership lifecycle for our managed partners (Silver through Platinum) and lead recruiting for our entry-level (Bronze) partners. You will work with a dedicated franchise Account Executive, the Mid-Market Sales team, Partner Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Legal. This role suits someone who enjoys building relationships with brand leaders, structuring agreements that work for both sides, and turning a growing partner portfolio into measurable customer growth.

sections.title: Recruit franchisor partners
bullets: Identify, qualify, and sign franchisors across emerging, growth-stage, and mature brands, with a focus on sectors such as health and wellness, children's businesses, and home services.
Run discovery on every new partner application and serve as the franchisor's main point of contact through onboarding.

Build outbound campaigns using prospect lists, partner referrals, franchise sales organizations, industry associations, and competitive displacement opportunities. Use AI and sales tools to research and reach decision-makers.
Represent Gusto at franchise industry events and trade shows, and follow up so those events turn into signed partners.

sections.title: Structure and manage partnerships
bullets: Place each new partner in the right program tier based on their expected franchisee growth and engagement.
Structure and negotiate partner agreements, working with Legal and Revenue Operations on terms such as offers, revenue share, and co-marketing commitments.

Own the full lifecycle for managed (Silver–Platinum) partners: onboarding, joint planning, performance reviews, and renewals. Recruit and onboard Bronze partners, who are supported mainly through our partner management platform.
Agree on rules of engagement with each partner that set how Gusto may reach their franchisees, so outreach is welcome and the brand relationship is protected.

sections.title: About Gusto
paras: AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

sections.title: By the Numbers:
bullets: Named #1 best software for small business of 2024 by G2
2,700+ employees in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and Turkiye and growing
Over $500M in annual revenue
The SMB market is large (and growing!) with huge opportunities for Gusto to make an incredible impact for SMBs
There are 6.2M employers in the US, 98% have fewer than 100 employees (1)
550,000 new businesses are created each year in the US (1)

sections.title: What Product Management is like at Gusto:
bullets: Our Product team is lean, which means you’ll have a high degree of impact and ownership. We believe in smaller, empowered teams that move quickly with less overhead. You’ll move fast by pairing sharp product judgment with fluency in AI tools, automating what slows teams down and amplifying what makes them creative and high-performing.

We’re boundaryless builders. Lines between roles are intentionally blurred, and our PMs do whatever it takes to deliver outcomes. You’ll prototype, automate, design, and ship, using AI as your co-builder to turn problems into durable solutions that deliver customer value with urgency and care.

We’re here to serve small and medium businesses. Gusto has a strong mission-driven culture, and we care deeply about lifting up these business owners, building technology for an AI-first world that gives them the superpowers to run and grow their businesses with confidence.

We’re comfortable with change. Our environment moves fast, and PMs here thrive in ambiguity, blending curiosity, experimentation, and AI-native craft to shape how products (and work itself) are built at Gusto.

sections.title: About the Team:
paras: HR Experiences (HRX) builds the products that help small businesses hire, onboard, develop, and stay compliant: hiring and I-9s, performance, handbooks, training, labor law posters, and the tools our HR Partners use to serve their clients. Most of our customers are a department of one, an owner or office manager making consequential people decisions with no HR team to check their work.

Today we serve those customers mostly through software built in the GUI era: prescribed workflows and screens that customers have to learn, with human HR experts and advisory experiences for a growing set of them. For a meaningful segment, learning our workflows is not a must-have, and a GUI can never cover the long tail of needs that hundreds of thousands of businesses have. The opportunity ahead of us is to rebuild how HR gets delivered so that the product does the work and carries the judgment of an expert, and to make it AI-native from the start rather than a chat box bolted onto a GUI.

As Principal Product Manager, you'll be a senior individual contributor who owns the People Page experience and sets the experience direction for the HR Suite. You'll also own Training, which is where you'll build and learn quickly. You'll work hand in hand with the PM who owns the other verticals (Hiring, Onboarding, and Performance).

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.blurb: Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see…
jobs.summary:
Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

About the Team
AI has made it possible to build almost anything. The constraint on great software is no longer engineering capacity, its judgment about what’s actually worth building. Product Managers at Mixpanel build products that help customers answer that question, and they dig deep into customer problems to answer it themselves.

sections.title: About Mixpanel
paras: Mixpanel’s Product Managers operate with high ownership and trust. As a team, we focus on helping every builder, not just the ones with a statistics background, get real answers out of messy product data and make the judgment calls that separate delightful products from bloated ones.

We’re also our own best customer. The team uses Mixpanel every day to build Mixpanel: testing our own product intuitions against our own data and catching what works and what doesn’t before our users ever see it.

About the Role
As a Director of Product Management for Core Product, you’ll lead a mid-sized team of Product Managers who are responsible for the key revenue-driving surface areas at Mixpanel.. You’ll own strategy for this group while developing the people and practices that help the whole team do their best work. You’ll partner closely with product leadership to set direction, raise the bar on product craft, and create leverage across the org.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Lead, mentor and grow a team of Product Managers through coaching, feedback and career development
Set product strategy and direction across your area using customer conversations, market insight and Mixpanel’s own product data
Raise the bar on product craft across the team, including written communication, prioritization, experimentation and storytelling
Prioritize ruthlessly across a long list of possible bets, balancing customer impact, business value and team capacity
Define and track the metrics that show whether what your team shipped actually worked, and course-correct when it didn’t
Align engineering, design, sales, marketing and support around a shared roadmap and set of priorities
Tell a clear story about what your team has shipped to internal and external audiences, leading with the customer problem and using customer stories to make the value tangible
Stay close to the market and competitive landscape to inform where Mixpanel should invest next

sections.title: We’re Looking For Someone Who Has
bullets: 7+ years of product management experience
Experience managing a team of Product Managers and acting as a player-coach
A track record of developing, articulating and executing product strategies that drove measurable business outcomes
Experience coaching PMs and building strong product practices and rituals
Deep experience doing user research and working with customers to test product hypotheses
An ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals to drive clarity on what to build
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and aligning cross-functional teams
Experience using AI tools in product management workflows (e.g., competitive research, prototyping)

sections.title: Bonus Points For
bullets: Experience using Mixpanel as an end customer
Experience in B2B SaaS, analytics or data products
Experience writing production-grade software
Experience designing products using tools like Figma, Sketch or Abstract

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data
jobs.blurb: Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see…
jobs.summary: Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

sections.title: About the Role
paras: The core of Mixpanel’s value to customers has always been great data. We’re in an exciting moment for the way our users are thinking about and working with product data, and we need help figuring out how our position in the data infrastructure stack evolves. That’s why we’re hiring a fantastic Product Manager for Mixpanel Data.

In this role, you'll own Mixpanel's strategy and roadmap for where we sit in the data landscape - how our data architecture evolves, where we build versus integrate versus get out of the way, and what it means for Mixpanel to work with data that increasingly lives outside our walls as well as inside them. This is a pathfinding role: a large part of the job is turning ambiguous technical and business tradeoffs into a clear point of view, a roadmap, and decisions the engineering and leadership team can act on.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Define and drive Mixpanel's strategy and roadmap for how the product evolves alongside customers' data warehouses, lakes, and the broader modern data stack
Turn complex, ambiguous architecture and business tradeoffs into a clear recommendation, grounded in customer evidence, competitive context, and business impact
Partner closely with engineering leadership on build-vs-integrate-vs-partner decisions that shape Mixpanel's data architecture for years to come
Talk directly to customers and prospects to understand how their data infrastructure and workflows are changing, and translate that into product bets
Build the business case for infrastructure-level investments, making the ROI of foundational, long-horizon work legible to leadership
Define how Mixpanel's data model, governance, and metadata need to evolve to support deeper analysis and a growing product portfolio
Align engineering, design, and go-to-market teams around a shared strategic point of view, with clear, written communication
Define and track the metrics that tell you whether the strategy is working, and course-correct as new evidence comes in

sections.title: What We're Looking For
bullets: 5+ years of hands-on product management experience, including ownership of technically complex, infrastructure- or platform-level problems

jobs.title: University Grad | Customer Experience Associate
jobs.blurb: Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk…
jobs.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.

In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high-signal judgment calls throughout the day.
You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support. You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.
Diagnose across a broad product surface. Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.

Build and shape AI tools, not just use them. Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. You're not just a user — you're a builder. We are all builders at Ramp.

Communicate with precision and empathy. Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.

sections.title: What You Need
bullets: You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.
You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.
You're fast-moving while holding yourself to a high bar for execution: you balance speed, accuracy, and thoroughness in every interaction.
You can hold a technical conversation about how systems connect (APIs, bank integrations, accounting software) even if you're not writing code.
You manage competing priorities without dropping things. When you have 15 open issues across 4 internal teams, nothing falls through.
You write clearly and concisely. You can explain a payment reconciliation issue to a CFO without jargon.
You're comfortable on the phone. Many interactions start there.
You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding key performance standards, including CSAT, QA, and speed-of-service metrics.

jobs.summary:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to…

sections.title: An overview of this role
paras: As a Customer Success Engineer , you'll help customers get real, measurable value from GitLab after the sale by providing technical product expertise and best practice guidance. You'll be part of the customer success engineer team that delivers GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements.

This is a pooled model, so you won't be dedicated to a specific set of accounts. You'll collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, and Renewals Managers to support implementation, architecture, and use case adoption across GitLab's key workflows, including source code management, continuous integration and delivery, DevSecOps, and Agile Planning. You'll report to the Customer Success Engineer Team Manager , and your first-year outcomes will focus on building trusted advisor relationships, enabling successful customer implementations, and creating reusable workshops and technical content that helps customers adopt GitLab at scale.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Engage with customers via Zoom calls and email as a technical consultant during the post-sales journey, providing product, solution, and best-practice guidance.
Partner with Customer Success Managers to go deep on GitLab use case implementation (for example: source code management, continuous integration, continuous delivery, DevSecOps, and Agile Planning).
Deliver practical, customer-specific enablement through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements in a pooled support model (not dedicated to a single account)
Provide technical and architectural guidance that helps customers adopt GitLab capabilities and connect technical decisions to the outcomes they care about.
Align with Account Executives and Renewals Managers to share customer-facing subject matter expertise that supports customer business objectives
Develop and deliver workshops, demos, and other reusable enablement content in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
Build and maintain specialty competency in one or more technologies aligned to GitLab's market focus through training, certification, and creating working examples for internal and customer use.
Contribute to customer-facing learning resources, including GitLab documentation, YouTube content, and enablement programs such as the Digital Journey.

sections.title: What you'll bring
bullets: Experience supporting one or more GitLab use cases (source code management, continuous integration, continuous delivery, DevSecOps, or Agile Planning) and enabling customers with practical, in-depth guidance.
Proficiency with DevSecOps tools or adjacent highly technical tooling, with the ability to translate tool capabilities into customer outcomes.
Technical background in software development or systems engineering, including comfort discussing architecture, workflows, and implementation tradeoffs.
Ability to communicate complex technical and organizational topics clearly in writing and live settings (Zoom calls, workshops, and presentations).
Experience operating as a trusted technical advisor to customer and business stakeholders in a post-sales environment.
Strong time management and prioritization skills, including the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements and cross-functional requests in a pooled model.

Continuous learning mindset, including maintaining specialty competency through training, certification, documentation, or creation of reusable examples; we welcome transferable experience from related roles and backgrounds.

sections.title: About the team
paras: We're a globally distributed customer success engineer (CSE) team supporting customers in GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier. We collaborate asynchronously and stay aligned through clear documentation and shared enablement assets. We continuously improve our content and delivery based on what we learn from customer engagements.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

sections.title: An Overview of This Role
paras: As Director of Product, SaaS Platforms, you'll own the product direction and business outcomes for GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) environments: GitLab.com, our multi-tenant platform, and GitLab Dedicated, our single-tenant offering. You'll connect reliability, scalability, and operability with the commercial decisions that make these platforms sustainable businesses.

Your scope spans both platforms, not a single feature roadmap. On GitLab.com, you'll guide growth through better customer isolation and additional cells, alongside rate limits, usage limits, and monetization. On GitLab Dedicated, you'll help scale it to hundreds of customers through automation, customer self-service, and closer alignment with GitLab's latest releases. You'll balance customer needs with operating costs and gross margin.
This director-level role starts as an individual contributor. It's remote and open to candidates based in the United States or Canada, with no specific time zone preference.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Set the product strategy and roadmap across GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated, connecting platform capabilities to customer and business outcomes.
Drive improvements in platform reliability, scalability, and operability, including better separation between customers and expansion of GitLab.com's cell-based architecture.
Define GitLab.com's rate limits, usage limits, and related monetization approach.
Scale GitLab Dedicated through maintenance-window automation and other operational improvements, while controlling costs and improving gross margin.
Expand customer self-service through Switchboard, giving customers tools to monitor, observe, and operate their Dedicated tenants.
Guide capabilities such as customer-initiated disaster recovery and geographic redundancy, and enable earlier access to beta features on GitLab Dedicated.
Reduce the delay between GitLab releases and their availability on Dedicated.
Own the business side of the portfolio as well as the technical product direction, developing profit and loss (P&L) ownership for both platforms and helping establish GitLab.com as a P&L business.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
paras: Direct ownership of a product P&L is particularly valuable. Experience in an organization actively adopting artificial intelligence (AI) would also be helpful.
bullets: Experience leading a product portfolio at director level or with comparable scope, setting direction across multiple related products rather than a single roadmap.
Technical product experience with cloud platforms, infrastructure, or SaaS environments, including the tradeoffs involved in reliability, scalability, and operations.
The ability to connect product decisions to commercial outcomes, including monetization, operating costs, and gross margin.
Experience translating complex platform challenges into product priorities and working across teams to deliver them.
The ability to lead through product direction and influence in a director-level individual contributor role.

sections.title: About the Team
paras: The SaaS platform portfolio brings together GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated. The work spans shared-platform growth, single-tenant operations, and the tools customers use to manage their environments. The challenge is to improve the customer experience and platform capabilities while building a scalable, financially sustainable operating model for each offering.

At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our platform brings together development, security, and operations, helping teams collaborate throughout software delivery.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

paras: The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
bullets: Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
Demonstrate a willingness to learn, investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues for customers.
Build trusted relationships with operational and executive stakeholders, and become their long-term partner at Samsara.
Drive adoption and measurable value by leading strategic customer engagements, product consultations, and value check-ins that remove barriers and help customers get the most out of Samsara.
Own your book of Mid-Market customers from adoption through Renewal: Proactively identify, forecast, escalate and mitigate renewal risk.

Partner with Account Executives to identify and close expansion opportunities through deep customer relationships and product conversations, uncovering where additional Samsara solutions can drive more value.
Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.

sections.title: Total Rewards
paras: At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

sections.title: Flexible Working
paras: At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

sections.title: Our Commitment to Authenticity
paras: We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

sections.title: About Gusto
paras: AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: The most senior individual-contributor seat in Solutions/Sales Engineering, not defined by a stage in the customer journey, but by scope: you're the final technical escalation point for Solutions Engineering, and the person who sets technical strategy and standard for the function as a whole. Where other Solutions Engineers own the deepest technical work on a given deal, you own the problems and decisions that span deals, route-to-market segments, and teams, like the ones with no existing playbook because nobody's had to solve them at this scale before. You're equally credible sketching an API flow with an engineer and discussing technical roadmap with an exec. In practice, that often means owning the deep API and OAuth-level integration and customization work behind the organization's highest-value enterprise and partner deals, the work that has historically had no clear owner, leaving sales and delivery teams to chase down the technical follow-through themselves.

sections.title: Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:
bullets: Serve as the final technical escalation point for the rarest, highest-ambiguity problems — the ones with no existing playbook.
Set standing technical strategy and direction for Solutions Engineering as a function, independent of any single route to market or deal.

Represent Solutions Engineering directly in cross-functional and executive conversations with Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership — translating technical reality into business decisions and vice versa.
Mentor and set the technical bar for the broader Solutions Engineering team — including coaching on the judgment calls that come with full deal/technical autonomy.

Own the technical strategy — and the hands-on build — behind the org's highest-stakes, most cross-functional initiatives: deep API and OAuth-based integration work for enterprise and partner accounts, from initial authorization through ongoing customization, end-to-end.

Act as the technical through-line between engineering/platform teams and go-to-market teams on the largest deals — making sure a committed integration or customization actually ships for the customer, instead of leaving that follow-through to sales.
Turn bespoke, one-off integration builds into reusable patterns and tooling other accounts and partners can adopt, rather than re-solving the same problem for every new deal.
Influence product and engineering roadmap from a position of pattern-recognition across the entire SE function, not just your own book.

sections.title: Here’s what we're looking for:
bullets: 8–12+ years of relevant experience, with significant time in a senior technical pre-sales, solutions-architecture, or implementation leadership role.
Proven track record operating independently on the most complex, highest-stakes technical problems an organization has — not just executing an established playbook.
Comfortable and credible in both a whiteboard session with engineers and a strategy conversation with executives — able to translate fluently between the two.
Demonstrated experience setting technical direction or standards across a team or function, not just for your own accounts.
Strong track record influencing product/engineering roadmap through structured technical feedback and pattern recognition across many accounts or problems.

Deep fluency across Gusto's technical surface area — Salesforce/CRM, API and integration architecture (including OAuth/token-based authorization flows), payroll/tax/compliance systems — sufficient to be the final word when others can't resolve something.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Ads Quality
jobs.blurb: At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless…
jobs.summary:
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

sections.title: Instacart is a Flex First team
paras: There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

sections.title: Overview
paras: Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media ecosystems, helping brands connect with shoppers at the moment of intent on Instacart Marketplace and 310+ partners. Sponsored Products is our anchor format, and its growth depends on how we merchandise and display products to consumers as well as the relevance, ranking, and personalization that drive customer and advertiser value.

As a Principal Product Manager on the Ad Product team, you will own the strategy for Ads Quality across the Sponsored Products franchise. You will partner with engineering, design, data science, and user research to build a virtuous flywheel between advertisers, customers and retailers; and to help define the future of how online grocery works.

sections.title: About the Job
bullets: Create surface-level controls that balance customer value and advertiser value across Sponsored Products
Drive a high-velocity experimentation program in merchandising, ranking, and relevance - with a goal of shipping experiments that deliver multi-million dollar ARR impact.
Develop a comprehensive strategy for evolving our ranking and monetization systems to better represent customer intent per ad request
Lead system design for complex ranking and relevance systems in partnership with Machine Learning engineers, and advance improvements to core retrieval and ranking that power Sponsored Products
Establish yourself as a thought leader on search and how to monetize it as a surface, sharing your point of view internally and externally with partners and industry leaders
Define how Sponsored Products evolve in new experiences such as agentic commerce and conversational UI’s
Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and UX research to turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into clear hypotheses, requirements, and measurable outcomes

sections.title: Minimum Qualifications
bullets: Experience with paid search or Sponsored Products advertising
Experience building machine learning products, including ranking, relevance, or recommendation systems
Experience with consumer-facing digital product work at a large, complex technology company
Strong analytical skills and data science savvy, with a record of using data to guide product decisions and design experiments.
Critical thinking and executive presence, with the ability to present complex subject matter to senior leaders and build cross-organizational buy-in.
Willingness to travel approximately 25% of the time.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Organizational Units
jobs.blurb: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and…
jobs.summary:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Organizational Units team, you will own the structural layer of Vanta for enterprise customers. This includes Org Unit object, the access and permissions model for org units, and the reporting that rolls up across units. You’ll define the foundation that powers Vanta’s product teams, public API, MCP, and Vanta Agent—enabling agents to act safely within large enterprises.

sections.title: What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager at Vanta:
bullets: Own the organizational unit creation, management, reporting, and permission-related workflows
Build agent-first experiences to support organization management and insights through agents, with clear requirements for authorization, human review, and traceability

Work directly with our largest customers and prospects, and with enterprise sales and customer success, to understand how real organizations are structured and turn that into clear, prioritized specs with acceptance criteria
Partner with design and engineering teams to deliver a high quality product to our largest customers in an area where a wrong data model decision is expensive to unwind
Partner with our go-to-market teams to tell the Vanta enterprise story to customers and prospects

Distill complex problems and opportunities into clearly prioritized product goals for your team, collaborate with partner teams, and drive high-quality execution in collaboration with stakeholders across the company
Deliver a high quality product addressing key customer pain points and creating opportunities for competitive advantage

sections.title: How to be successful in this role:
bullets: Have 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality SaaS/B2B to enterprises
Have strong technical skills and experience working on cross-platform initiatives, in highly complex areas
Experience owning technical platform capabilities used by multiple teams or products
Have experience working with LLMs, writing evals, and building agent-first experiences
Possess a customer-focused mindset– proactively reach out to customers, synthesize feedback, and partner with go-to-market teams
Be deeply curious, empathetic, and user-centric, with a knack for driving effective collaboration among diverse stakeholders
Communicate with clarity and influence—both written and verbal—with team members, stakeholders, and executives
Be data driven– you lean into qual signals from users and can dig into the quant side to inform roadmap & prioritization

sections.title: What you can expect as a Vanta’n:
paras: To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.
bullets: Industry-competitive salary and equity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans
16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents
Health & wellness stipend
Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend
Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office
Family planning benefits
Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

sections.title: About Vanta
paras: We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

You will partner closely with both executive sponsors and day-to-day end users/practitioners to drive adoption and measurable outcomes.

Reporting to the Director of Customer Success Managers , you will coach Customer Success Managers to support account health across onboarding, adoption stages, executive business reviews, and renewals, while also improving how the team works.

sections.title: What you'll do

Coach team members through regular feedback, development support, and career growth conversations to strengthen knowledge, communication, and execution.
Partner with the Director of Customer Success Managers to define team goals, clarify responsibilities, and align priorities with company direction.
Manage resource assignments, staffing levels, and hiring activity to support team coverage and customer needs.
Develop senior-level relationships with customers and support the team in building trusted advisor partnerships.
Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and other internal teams to create a consistent customer experience.
Support customers during escalations by working with other leaders to coordinate clear, effective responses.
Improve the processes and tools used by the team and oversee initiatives tied to objectives and key results.

sections.title: What you'll bring
bullets: Experience leading customer-facing teams in software, technology, consulting, sales, or customer success environments.
Ability to guide teams that drive software adoption and manage customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, business reviews, and renewals.
Knowledge of software development lifecycle practices, related tools, and agile or DevOps ways of working.

Familiarity with cloud or container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, application security concepts such as static application security testing (SAST) and dynamic application security testing (DAST), or cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure.
Skill in translating strategy into clear initiatives, coordinating execution, and tracking delivery across competing priorities.
Capability to lead distributed teams across regions, cultures, and lines of business, while working effectively with senior executives and external stakeholders.
Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and team events, as needed.
Strength in communication, coaching, feedback, delegation, planning, and process improvement.

sections.title: About the team
paras: On the Customer Success Management team, we are accountable for customer adoption, measurable outcomes, customer satisfaction, and building customer advocacy across GitLab.

We also act as a key connection point between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem, helping streamline collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other partners.

In this role, you will manage a team in North America while collaborating asynchronously with stakeholders across regions, with a focus on helping customers succeed at scale and improving how the organization supports them.

You'll also improve renewal workflows so customers experience seamless continuity with GitLab's platform.
bullets: Implementing automated outreach sequences to engage customers throughout their renewal lifecycle

jobs.summary: At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

sections.title: What you will do as a Customer Engineer
paras: The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.

sections.title: Minimum Qualifications
bullets: Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).
Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.
Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.

Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.
Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.
Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:
Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.
Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.

sections.title: Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")
bullets: Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms.
Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.
Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.

Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.
